objectives.statement: Recognize when a Norwegian adjective is being used as an adverb to describe a verb.
Choose the neuter -t form or unchanged common form when an adjective describes an action.
Build short sentences with the adjective-adverb in a natural position after the verb or verb phrase.
Find and fix simple errors where an English-style form or noun-describing form is used for an action.

notes: Must teach that adjectives double as adverbs in their neuter (-t) or common form to modify a verb (e.g. synger vakkert, kjører fort). Contrast briefly with English -ly. Defer comparison (penere/penest) to adjective_comparison and adjective agreement to adjective_agreement.
